en_title: Resident Evil Requiem Was Originally Planned as an Online Game, Producer Says
cn_title: 《生化危机：安魂曲》据称原拟网游
subtitle: 重新把恐怖放在首位
opus_summary: 川田将央透露，《生化危机：安魂曲》原本按网游开发，但中途调研结果不理想，团队转而优先考虑恐怖体验。里昂最早确定担任主角，团队后因恐怖感不足而加入格蕾丝。

paragraphs.en: Resident Evil Requiem producer Masachika Kawata revealed that the game was originally planned to be an online title before they scrapped the idea to focus on horror.
paragraphs.cn: 《生化危机：安魂曲》制作人川田将央透露，本作最初计划做成网络游戏，但团队后来放弃了这一想法，转而专注于恐怖体验。

paragraphs.en: Kawata shared this information in the BIOHAZARD 30th Special Mook (‘magazine book’), a 124-page, full-color fan book with a complete history of the series' timeline, creature genealogy, and developer interviews.
paragraphs.cn: 川田将央在《BIOHAZARD 30th Special Mook》中分享了这一消息。这本面向粉丝的全彩杂志书共124页，收录了系列完整时间线、生物谱系及开发者访谈。

paragraphs.en: “Every game is a continuous process of trial and error. For example, with Resident Evil Requiem, [game director Koshi Nakanishi] initially went so far as to develop it as an online game,” he said, via a fan translation.
paragraphs.cn: 根据粉丝翻译，川田将央表示：「每款游戏的开发都是不断试错的过程。比如《生化危机：安魂曲》，［游戏总监中西晃史］最初甚至已经按网络游戏的方向展开了开发。」

paragraphs.en: “However, the results of research conducted partway through development were not favorable, so we decided to prioritize the horror concept once again and abandoned the online direction.”
paragraphs.cn: 「不过，开发中途的调研结果并不理想，因此我们决定再次把恐怖理念放在首位，放弃了网络游戏的方向。」

paragraphs.en: That’s not the only wild thing Kawata revealed in the mook; he also said that Leon was the first character the team chose as a protagonist, but they ultimately felt that being able to hack and slash zombies with ease would lean too heavily on the ‘action’ side of things, making the overall game less scary.
paragraphs.cn: 这并不是川田将央在这本杂志书中透露的唯一一件令人意外的事。他还表示，里昂是团队最早选定的主角，但团队最终认为，如果玩家能轻松砍杀丧尸，游戏就会过于偏重「动作」，整体恐怖感也会减弱。

paragraphs.en: “Leon was also the first character confirmed to appear as a protagonist. However, we determined that with Leon alone, who excels in combat, ‘horror would no longer work,’ so it was decided to introduce Grace as a new character,” he continued.
paragraphs.cn: 他接着说：「里昂也是最早确定以主角身份登场的角色。不过，我们判断，如果只有擅长战斗的里昂，恐怖就无法成立，因此决定引入新角色格蕾丝。」

paragraphs.en: Kawata also explained why Capcom decided to wait before sharing Leon’s involvement in the game, saying, “by keeping the full picture of the game, which would develop along both the horror and action sides, until the very end, we were able to successfully maintain interest in it up until release.”
paragraphs.cn: 川田将央也解释了卡普空为何没有早早公布里昂会在本作中登场：「这款游戏会同时展现恐怖与动作两面，而我们直到最后才揭晓游戏的全貌，成功让大家在发售前一直保持关注。」

paragraphs.en: Nakanishi’s early plans to make RE9 an online game isn’t something totally surprising, given that management at Capcom had also pushed for Resident Evil 7 to have multiplayer and microtransactions during its conceptual phase.
paragraphs.cn: 中西晃史早期打算将《生化危机9》做成网络游戏，并不完全令人意外。毕竟，在《生化危机7》的概念构思阶段，卡普空管理层也曾要求加入多人模式和微交易。

paragraphs.en: "Right around that time, there was a big push at Capcom, a big 'marketing' push, saying 'we have to make the games players are asking for,'" franchise producer Jun Takeuchi said in 2022. "So we were being told 'make this, make that', it was really hard on the directors at the time. 'Online multiplayer' this, 'downloadable content' that. 'Ongoing service games! Microtransactions! Make a Resident Evil game that ticks all those boxes!'
paragraphs.cn: 系列制作人竹内润在2022年表示：「就在那段时间，卡普空大力推动营销，强调我们必须做出玩家想要的游戏。所以我们一直被要求做这个、做那个，当时的总监们真的很难。一下要在线多人模式，一下要可下载内容。还要持续运营！微交易！做一款把这些要求全部满足的《生化危机》！」

paragraphs.en: “The idea of multiplayer got killed off pretty quickly. If we could properly put it together, we could make an exciting horror multiplayer game, but we didn’t really have any good ideas, so we set it aside. We went down the list, chopping them out, until we had marketing’s worst nightmare — a regular old single-player horror game."
paragraphs.cn: 「多人模式的想法很快就被否决了。如果能把各个部分妥善整合，我们就能做出一款刺激的多人恐怖游戏，但我们实在没有什么好点子，所以先把它搁置了。我们顺着清单逐一砍掉这些内容，最后做出了营销部门最不想看到的东西——一款普普通通的传统单人恐怖游戏。」

paragraphs.en: Capcom is moving full speed ahead with many of its high-profile IPs, Resident Evil being one of them. The series just enjoyed a film adaptation directed by Zach Cregger, and a Code Veronica remake is set to release in February next year. Given that the devs of RE9 didn’t move forward with an online version of the game, it’s possible that we see another online Resident Evil title in the future — perhaps another Resident Evil Outbreak?
paragraphs.cn: 卡普空正全力推进旗下多个知名IP，《生化危机》便是其中之一。系列刚刚推出了由扎克·克雷格执导的改编电影，《生化危机：代号维罗妮卡》重制版则定于明年2月发售。既然《生化危机9》的开发团队没有继续推进网络游戏版本，我们未来或许还会看到另一款《生化危机》网络游戏——也许会是另一部《生化危机：爆发》？
